study_identification_part.si4_title: A 10-Year Longitudinal Study of Brain Cortical Thickness in People with FirstEpisode Psychosis Using Normative Models

answer: Reference normative models from pooled multi-site datasets (77 sites; 40,435 participants with 95% healthy training, 2,548 held-out validation)
TOP longitudinal first-episode psychosis cohort with controls (baseline n=218, 12-month n=197, 10-year n=77) and patients (baseline n=79, 12-month n=67, 10-year n=23)
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Large external pooled datasets provided normative cortical thickness models; TOP study supplies longitudinal scans across three timepoints for schizophrenia spectrum patients and healthy controls
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Using pooled data from a collection of mostly publicly available datasets from 77 sites, and 40 435 participants, the reference normative models were first trained on (95%) healthy individuals and validated on an independent set of 2548 CTRL and patients (5%, stratified by sites). ... Structural MRI from people with first-episode psychosis and controls (n = 79 and 218) were obtained at enrollment, after 12 months (n = 67 and 197), and 10 years (n = 23 and 77)."

answer.Reference pooled datasets: train and validate hierarchical Bayesian normative CT models; provide priors for transfer learning
answer.TOP cohort: adapt models to Oslo scanners and generate deviation scores for longitudinal case-control and symptom analyses

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Reference models trained externally; transferred to the three Oslo scanners using held-out controls, then applied to longitudinal controls and schizophrenia patients to compute regional deviation scores and track change over 10 years
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We estimated a normative model ... using HBR with age as a covariate, and sex and scanner id as batch effects... The reference normative models were first trained ... We then adapted the model to the 3 unseen Oslo scanners ... After this transfer step, we tested the normative models on the remaining longitudinal CTRL and SCZ samples and obtained individual deviation scores"

dc3_number_of_healthy_control.detail: Reference training pool included 40,435 participants (95% healthy) before validation; TOP study baseline control group counts 218 individuals used for adaptation and longitudinal evaluation (no explicit split reported)
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.supporting_text: "Using pooled data ... 40 435 participants ... trained on (95%) healthy individuals" and "Structural MRI ... controls ( n = 79 and 218) were obtained at enrollment"
